basics.name: Vuk Svilaric
basics.label: Senior Backend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior backend engineer in Toronto building payments infrastructure, identity and AI-native workflows.

work.name: Tim Hortons Financial Services / Loyalty, RBI
highlights: Architected the transaction processing workflow for the Tims Financial credit card, owning the backend architecture and frontend integration.
Redesigned and reimplemented the Google Pay integration for an app with 10M+ monthly active users, standardizing it as a reusable component and improving the mobile payment experience across the app.
Led the Canadian Tire and Tim Hortons partnership end to end, integrating partner services for OIDC account linking and rewards earning, with 200,000 users linked in the first week of launch.

Prototyped an LLM assistant using Amazon Bedrock flows that answered engineers' questions about the team's existing AWS architecture, an early exploration of using generative AI for internal developer tooling.
Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor) daily across design, implementation, testing and code review on production payment and loyalty services.

work.name: Carfax
highlights: Led the migration of the leads service from a monolith to a distributed AWS serverless microservice, significantly improving scalability and maintainability.
Integrated the in-house Leads API with third-party OEM and dealer lead tracking systems to streamline lead management.
Engineered a Facebook Marketplace chatbot that processes over 1,000,000 Carfax listings daily, generating 10,000+ leads and an estimated $26 million in additional yearly revenue.
Maintained high service availability with a multi-region disaster recovery failover solution and full-suite integration testing.

work.name: Scotiabank
highlights: Led development of a custom Node.js API gateway serving all internal bank APIs.
Implemented custom cryptographic security with JWT, JWS, JWE and mutual TLS.
Wrote performance-critical code using multi-process Node.js clustering.
Developed internet-facing API solutions using Apigee Edge policies and custom Java callouts.

work.name: IBM
work.position: Software Engineer Intern, WebSphere Application Server
highlights: Built new features and provided support for WebSphere Application Server (WAS), used by banks around the world across on-prem, cloud and lightweight Liberty deployments.

Worked directly with the OpenAPI Spec founders (SmartBear) on the Java EE openapi-3.0 feature, which exposes OpenAPI 3.0 and Swagger 2.0 docs by scanning annotations in JAX-RS RESTful web applications.
Owned the build system of 50+ virtual machines for the entire XML Technologies component of WAS.

education.area: Computer Engineering, focus in Software Engineering
